  "patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: /private/tmp/reigh-chain-workspace/reigh-app/src/shared/components/ui/overlay/useOpenFromDataState.ts\n+import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\n+\n+function readOpenState(node: HTMLElement): boolean {\n+  const dataState = node.getAttribute('data-state');\n+  const dataOpen = node.getAttribute('data-open');\n+  return dataState === 'open' || dataOpen === '' || dataOpen === 'true';\n+}\n+\n+export function useOpenFromDataState(node: HTMLElement | null): boolean {\n+  const [open, setOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);\n+\n+  useEffect(() => {\n+    if (!node) {\n+      setOpen(false);\n+      return;\n+    }\n+\n+    const sync = () => {\n+      setOpen(readOpenState(node));\n+    };\n+\n+    sync();\n+\n+    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {\n+      sync();\n+    });\n+\n+    observer.observe(node, {\n+      attributes: true,\n+      attributeFilter: ['data-state', 'data-open'],\n+    });\n+\n+    return () => {\n+      observer.disconnect();\n+    };\n+  }, [node]);\n+\n+  return open;\n+}\n*** End Patch\n"
}

Collapsed bootstrap and overlay-open tradeoffs are intentionally deferred to M7B+.\n+\n+## Bootstrap Effect Key Discipline\n+Bootstrap effects that call a zustand setter must not depend on full RQ result objects.\n+Do not write `useEffect(() => bootstrap(query.data), [query.data])` because object identity churn will resync local state for the wrong reason.\n+Use the scalar React Query refetch key instead: `dataUpdatedAt`.\n+`dataUpdatedAt` belongs in the dep array because it changes when the authoritative fetch result genuinely refreshes.\n+The fetched object itself stays in a ref so the effect reads the latest snapshot without keying off identity.\n+This is the rule that now drives `useAutoSaveSettings.ts`.\n+The same rule also drives `useLastUsedEditSettings.ts`.\n+When `dataUpdatedAt` advances, re-bootstrap `cleanSnapshot` from the new authoritative payload.\n+When only object identity changes and `dataUpdatedAt` does not, do nothing.\n+Custom-mode bootstraps are entity-keyed rather than content-keyed.\n+If a custom-mode caller needs a new seed, it must change `entityId`.\n*** End Patch\n"
}

(flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked how remotion itself acquires delay handles in `node_modules/remotion/dist/cjs/iframe.js:8-18`. remotion's own components create the handle synchronously with `usestate(() => delayrender(...))`; the plan says 'calls delayrender() on mount', which reads like an effect-time action and leaves the initial-frame blocking behavior underspecified compared with the actual library pattern. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked the new `useaudioparam()` sketch against `src/tools/video-editor/effects/compileeffect.tsx:1-2`. the plan defines it in terms of `interpolate(audio[binding.source], ...)` but does not explicitly import `interpolate` into the new hook file or simplify it to straight arithmetic, so the helper's implementation contract is still looser than it needs to be.
